subtitle: A pebble cove on Ibiza's west coast where the calm is enforced by a paid checkpoint contract and a bus-and-boat program running every summer since 2016, not by isolation.
spike_statement: Since 2016 Sant Antoni has run buses and boats to Cala Salada; since 2023 a €113,176-a-year contract has gated the road, citing extreme wildfire risk.

levers.photo_tone: Pine-backed pebble cove in flat afternoon light, a checkpoint barrier just visible at the edge of the access road
